jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE production sprite atlas for Magic Mail, a cheerful postal adventure mobile game. Genuine transparent alpha background. Match the illustrated casual game style of the supplied references: saturated rich colors, broad hand-painted gradients, plump rounded volumes, warm little highlights, clean dark inner contours and a thin continuous ivory-white OUTER outline. Not photorealistic, not plastic 3D rendering, not flat vector icons. Six independent grounded scenery sprites in a strict THREE-column TWO-row grid, large transparent gutters, one object centered completely inside each equal cell, no overlap, no labels, no background, no drop shadows detached from feet. Row-major subjects: 1 tree, 2 postal house, 3 lamp post, 4 mailbox on a short grounded post, 5 low simple broad bush, 6 cluster of flowers or rocks. Each house and mailbox has one small embossed envelope motif attached to the object, never floating. Simple readable shapes at mobile scale, consistent top-left light. Garden theme: emerald and lime tree with warm ochre twisting trunk, sunny cream postal cottage with deep violet roof and teal door, curved teal brass lantern facing LEFT, deep violet mailbox with gold door facing LEFT, bright coral red low shrub, yellow bell flowers with saturated emerald leaves. Strengthen warm highlights and deep colorful shadows similar to the volcanic illustration reference. No orange autumn tree: the tree is fresh vivid green. No tiny details.
